script: Some sauropods were the largest animals ever to walk on land. Argentinosaurus may have reached about 30 to 35 meters long. Scientists estimate it weighed around 70 tonnes. That is heavier than 10 African elephants. Its size is estimated from just a few giant bones, including huge back vertebrae. Even so, blue whales are heavier than any known dinosaur.
